card: Updates bip352_send_and_receive_vectors.json to match the canonical test vectors in the bitcoin/bips repository at commit 04393c98. This synchronizes Bitcoin Core's Silent Payments (BIP 352) test data with upstream changes, incorporating corrected input encodings and adding a Taproot annex test case that exercises annex-removal handling. No source or test runner code is modified.
evidence: PR description: 'The new Taproot annex test case (3c68d3f3), which covers an annex-removal error not caught by the previous vectors in Bitcoin Core's C++ tests.'
problem: Bitcoin Core's BIP 352 (Silent Payments) test fixture lagged behind the canonical specification repository, missing corrected input encodings and a Taproot annex test vector designed to catch annex-removal errors.

risk.why: It only updates static JSON test vectors, so any bug would manifest purely as a false-positive unit test failure in CI.

scope_notes: Touches only a JSON test fixture file.
summary: Updates bip352_send_and_receive_vectors.json to synchronize with the canonical BIP 352 test vectors from the bitcoin/bips repository at commit 04393c98. The changes incorporate corrected input encodings and add a Taproot annex test case without altering test logic or code.
